series.name: Carrier Comfort 22 ductless (45MHHAQ)
series.notes: Owner's manual Table 4 for the R-454B high-wall heat pump Comfort 22, 9k to 24k. Codes appear on the indoor unit digital tube, the manual notes the indicator lamps may keep flashing with them. DF and FC are normal status displays, not faults. Every code below was re-checked line by line against SplitAtlas, which cites this same manual.

title.en: Outdoor fan speed out of control
title.ur: Outdoor fan ki speed control se bahar

meaning.en: The outdoor fan is not holding the speed the board commands, so the unit may slow down or stop to protect itself.
meaning.ur: Outdoor fan jo speed board ne kahi wo pakad nahi pa rahi, is liye unit hifazat ke liye dheemi ho sakti hai ya ruk sakti hai.

causes.en: Outdoor fan motor is stuck, weak or one blade is broken.
causes.ur: Outdoor fan motor atka hua, kamzor hai ya blade toota hua hai.

causes.en: Fan speed feedback line has failed, so the board never sees the RPM it asked for.
causes.ur: Fan speed feedback line kharab hai, is liye board ko chahi hui RPM nahi milti.

solutions.en: Power off at the breaker for 10 minutes, switch back on and run the unit once.
solutions.ur: Breaker se 10 minute power off karein, phir on karke unit ek baar chalayein.

solutions.en: From outside only, clear anything blocking the outdoor unit and give it room to breathe.
solutions.ur: Sirf bahar se outdoor unit ke rukhawat hata dein aur khula space dein.

solutions.en: Technician to check the outdoor fan motor and blade, and replace what is faulty.
solutions.ur: Technician outdoor fan motor aur blade check kare aur kharab cheez badle.

source.title: Carrier 45MHHAQ High Wall Heat Pump Owner's Manual - Table 4 Error Codes

title.ur: Outdoor unit ki general kharabi

meaning.en: The outdoor unit has logged a fault but the display does not name one single part, so the board needs proper diagnosis.
meaning.ur: Outdoor unit ne fault record kiya hai par display koi ek hissa nahi batata, is liye board ki theek se diagnosis chahiye.

causes.en: Indoor to outdoor wiring (L, N, S) is loose, rat-bitten or landed wrongly.
causes.ur: Indoor se outdoor ki wiring (L, N, S) dheeli, chuha kata hui ya ghalat lagi hai.

causes.en: Indoor or outdoor heat exchanger is choked with dust and cannot breathe.
causes.ur: Indoor ya outdoor heat exchanger dust se band hai, unit saans nahi le pa rahi.

causes.en: The control board itself is faulty.
causes.ur: Control board hi kharab hai.

solutions.en: Power off at the breaker for 10 minutes, switch back on and run the unit once.
solutions.ur: Breaker se 10 minute power off karein, phir on karke unit ek baar chalayein.

solutions.en: From outside only, clear anything blocking the outdoor unit and give it room to breathe.
solutions.ur: Sirf bahar se outdoor unit ke rukhawat hata dein aur khula space dein.

solutions.en: Do not keep restarting - if the code returns, stop and book a technician.
solutions.ur: Bar bar restart na karein - code wapas aaye to rokein aur technician bulayein.

source.title: Carrier 45MHHAQ High Wall Heat Pump Owner's Manual - Table 4 Error Codes

title.ur: Outdoor unit ki EEPROM parameter kharabi

meaning.en: The outdoor board cannot read its stored configuration, so it no longer trusts its own settings.
meaning.ur: Outdoor board apni saved configuration parh nahi pata, is liye wo apni settings par bharosa nahi karti.

causes.en: Board memory data was corrupted after a power dip or surge.
causes.ur: Power fluctuation se board ki memory (EEPROM) data kharab ho gayi.

causes.en: The control board itself is faulty.
causes.ur: Control board hi kharab hai.

solutions.en: Power off at the breaker for 10 minutes, switch back on and run the unit once.
solutions.ur: Breaker se 10 minute power off karein, phir on karke unit ek baar chalayein.

solutions.en: After the reset, ask the technician to check the EEPROM chip seating on the board.
solutions.ur: Reset ke baad technician se EEPROM chip ki seating check karwayein.

solutions.en: If the wiring and sensors test fine, the main board needs replacing.
solutions.ur: Wiring aur sensor theek nikle to main board badalna hoga.

source.title: Carrier 45MHHAQ High Wall Heat Pump Owner's Manual - Table 4 Error Codes

title.ur: Outdoor coil temperature sensor kharabi

meaning.en: The outdoor coil temperature reading is missing or out of range, which blocks defrost and capacity control.
meaning.ur: Outdoor coil ka temperature reading nahi aa rahi ya ghalat hai, jiski wajah se defrost aur capacity control ruk jati hai.

causes.en: Sensor lead wire is loose, rat-bitten or shorted where it clips onto the pipe.
causes.ur: Sensor ki wire dheeli hai, chuha ne kaat di hai ya pipe par short ho rahi hai.

causes.en: The thermistor has drifted out of range or failed outright.
causes.ur: Thermistor kharab ho gaya hai ya uski reading ghalat aa rahi hai.

causes.en: Sensor has come off its sensing point on the coil or suction line.
causes.ur: Sensor coil ya suction line par apni jagah se hat gaya hai.

solutions.en: Power off at the breaker for 10 minutes, switch back on and run the unit once.
solutions.ur: Breaker se 10 minute power off karein, phir on karke unit ek baar chalayein.

solutions.en: Check the sensor plug and lead, then measure the thermistor and replace it if out of range.
solutions.ur: Sensor ka plug aur wire check karein, thermistor napein, ghalat ho to badlein.

solutions.en: If the wiring and sensors test fine, the main board needs replacing.
solutions.ur: Wiring aur sensor theek nikle to main board badalna hoga.

source.title: Carrier 45MHHAQ High Wall Heat Pump Owner's Manual - Table 4 Error Codes

title.ur: Compressor discharge temperature sensor kharabi

meaning.en: The discharge temperature sensor is not reading correctly, so compressor overheating protection cannot work properly.
meaning.ur: Discharge temperature sensor theek se reading nahi de raha, is liye compressor ki overheat protection sahi kaam nahi karti.

causes.en: Sensor lead wire is loose, rat-bitten or shorted where it clips onto the pipe.
causes.ur: Sensor ki wire dheeli hai, chuha ne kaat di hai ya pipe par short ho rahi hai.

causes.en: The thermistor has drifted out of range or failed outright.
causes.ur: Thermistor kharab ho gaya hai ya uski reading ghalat aa rahi hai.

causes.en: Filter drier, capillary or EXV is choked, so pressures run away.
causes.ur: Filter drier, capillary ya EXV block ho gaya hai, pressure balaa se nikal raha hai.

solutions.en: Power off at the breaker for 10 minutes, switch back on and run the unit once.
solutions.ur: Breaker se 10 minute power off karein, phir on karke unit ek baar chalayein.

solutions.en: Check the sensor plug and lead, then measure the thermistor and replace it if out of range.
solutions.ur: Sensor ka plug aur wire check karein, thermistor napein, ghalat ho to badlein.

solutions.en: Technician to check compressor winding, amp draw and starting gear before any restart.
solutions.ur: Technician compressor ki winding, ampere aur starting gear check kare, phir hi restart karein.

meaning.en: The indoor coil outlet sensor line is open or shorted, so the board is flying blind on coil temperature.
meaning.ur: Indoor coil outlet sensor ki line open ya short hai, is liye board coil temperature andaza nahi laga pa raha.

causes.en: Sensor lead wire is loose, rat-bitten or shorted where it clips onto the pipe.
causes.ur: Sensor ki wire dheeli hai, chuha ne kaat di hai ya pipe par short ho rahi hai.

causes.en: Sensor has come off its sensing point on the coil or suction line.
causes.ur: Sensor coil ya suction line par apni jagah se hat gaya hai.

causes.en: The thermistor has drifted out of range or failed outright.
causes.ur: Thermistor kharab ho gaya hai ya uski reading ghalat aa rahi hai.

solutions.ur: Breaker se 10 minute power off karein, phir on karke unit ek baar chalayein.

solutions.en: Check the sensor plug and lead, then measure the thermistor and replace it if out of range.
solutions.ur: Sensor ka plug aur wire check karein, thermistor napein, ghalat ho to badlein.

solutions.en: Clean the filters and both heat exchangers, then retry the unit.
solutions.ur: Filter aur dono heat exchanger saaf karke dobara chalayein.

title.ur: Indoor unit ki EEPROM kharabi

meaning.en: The indoor board has lost its stored data and cannot finish its own start-up checks.
meaning.ur: Indoor board ne apna data kho diya hai aur apne start-up checks mukammal nahi kar pa rahi.

causes.en: Board memory data was corrupted after a power dip or surge.
causes.ur: Power fluctuation se board ki memory (EEPROM) data kharab ho gayi.

causes.en: A connector on the board has worked loose or gone green with moisture.
causes.ur: Board ka connector dheeli ho gaya hai ya nami se green ho gaya hai.

solutions.en: Power off at the breaker for 10 minutes, switch back on and run the unit once.
solutions.ur: Breaker se 10 minute power off karein, phir on karke unit ek baar chalayein.

solutions.en: After the reset, ask the technician to check the EEPROM chip seating on the board.
solutions.ur: Reset ke baad technician se EEPROM chip ki seating check karwayein.

solutions.en: If the wiring and sensors test fine, the main board needs replacing.
solutions.ur: Wiring aur sensor theek nikle to main board badalna hoga.

source.title: Carrier 45MHHAQ High Wall Heat Pump Owner's Manual - Table 4 Error Codes

title.en: Indoor fan speed out of control
title.ur: Indoor fan ki speed control se bahar

meaning.en: The indoor fan is not running at the speed the board asked for, so cooling or heating output is cut back.
meaning.ur: Indoor fan jo speed board ne kahi wo nahi chal raha, is liye cooling ya heating kam ho jati hai.

causes.en: Indoor fan motor is weak, jammed or the blade is rubbing the scroll.
causes.ur: Indoor fan motor kamzor hai, atka hua hai ya blade ragad raha hai.

causes.en: Dirty filter or choked coil is starving the fan of airflow.
causes.ur: Ganda filter ya ganda coil ki wajah se hawa nahi ban rahi.

solutions.en: Clean the filters and both heat exchangers, then retry the unit.
solutions.ur: Filter aur dono heat exchanger saaf karke dobara chalayein.

solutions.en: Switch off power and free the fan blade by hand; replace the motor if it is tight or noisy.
solutions.ur: Power band karke haath se fan blade azadayin; motor tight/shor ho to badlein.

solutions.en: Do not keep restarting - if the code returns, stop and book a technician.
solutions.ur: Bar bar restart na karein - code wapas aaye to rokein aur technician bulayein.

source.title: Carrier 45MHHAQ High Wall Heat Pump Owner's Manual - Table 4 Error Codes

title.ur: Indoor unit ki EEPROM parameter kharabi

meaning.en: The stored parameters on the indoor board are wrong or unreadable, usually after a power dip or a board swap.
meaning.ur: Indoor board ki saved parameters ghalat ya parhi nahi ja rahi, aksar power dip ya board badalne ke baad.

causes.en: Board memory data was corrupted after a power dip or surge.
causes.ur: Power fluctuation se board ki memory (EEPROM) data kharab ho gayi.

causes.en: Indoor and outdoor units are from different platform or revision levels.
causes.ur: Indoor aur outdoor unit alag platform/revision ke hain.

solutions.en: Power off at the breaker for 10 minutes, switch back on and run the unit once.
solutions.ur: Breaker se 10 minute power off karein, phir on karke unit ek baar chalayein.

solutions.en: After the reset, ask the technician to check the EEPROM chip seating on the board.
solutions.ur: Reset ke baad technician se EEPROM chip ki seating check karwayein.

solutions.en: If the wiring and sensors test fine, the main board needs replacing.
solutions.ur: Wiring aur sensor theek nikle to main board badalna hoga.

source.title: Carrier 45MHHAQ High Wall Heat Pump Owner's Manual - Table 4 Error Codes

title.en: Indoor main board to display board communication error
title.ur: Indoor main board aur display board communication kharabi

meaning.en: The main board and the display board have stopped talking, so the code may show while other functions look dead.
meaning.ur: Main board aur display board aapas mein baat karna band kar dete hain, is liye code aata hai aur dobara functions bhi band ho sakte hain.

causes.en: Wired controller or display board link to the main board is disturbed.
causes.ur: Wired controller ya display board ki main board se link bigdi hui hai.

causes.en: Communication circuit on the indoor or outdoor board has failed.
causes.ur: Indoor ya outdoor board ka communication circuit kharab ho gaya hai.

solutions.en: Power cycle both units together; communication faults often clear after one clean restart.
solutions.ur: Dono units ka ek sath power cycle karein; communication fault aksar ek saaf restart se theek ho jata hai.

solutions.en: Power off, then re-check and retighten the indoor-outdoor terminals (L, N, S, earth).
solutions.ur: Power band karke indoor-outdoor terminals (L, N, S, earth) dobara check aur tight karein.

solutions.en: If the wiring and sensors test fine, the main board needs replacing.
solutions.ur: Wiring aur sensor theek nikle to main board badalna hoga.

source.title: Carrier 45MHHAQ High Wall Heat Pump Owner's Manual - Table 4 Error Codes

title.ur: Drain pan mein paani ke level ka alarm

meaning.en: The drain pan has filled up, so the unit has locked out to stop water dripping into the room or ceiling.
meaning.ur: Drain pan bhar gaya hai, is liye unit ne lock kiya taake paani kamre ya ceiling mein na gire.

causes.en: Drain tray or outlet is blocked, so condensate has backed up.
causes.ur: Drain tray ya outlet band hai, piche se paani jam gaya hai.

causes.en: Water level switch wiring is wet or the tray sensor is stuck.
causes.ur: Water level switch ki wire geeli hai ya tray sensor atka hua hai.

solutions.en: Clear the drain line and clean out the drain tray so water can run off freely.
solutions.ur: Drain line khol dein aur drain tray saaf karke paani azaad bahar aane dein.

solutions.en: Power off at the breaker for 10 minutes, switch back on and run the unit once.
solutions.ur: Breaker se 10 minute power off karein, phir on karke unit ek baar chalayein.

solutions.en: Do not keep restarting - if the code returns, stop and book a technician.
solutions.ur: Bar bar restart na karein - code wapas aaye to rokein aur technician bulayein.

source.title: Carrier 45MHHAQ High Wall Heat Pump Owner's Manual - Table 4 Error Codes

title.en: External fan DC bus voltage too low
title.ur: External fan ki DC bus voltage bohat kam

meaning.en: The supply feeding the external fan driver has sagged below the level the board will run on.
meaning.ur: External fan driver ko di ja rahi supply board ki had se neeche gir gayi hai.

causes.en: External fan module supply has sagged or spiked.
causes.ur: External fan module ki supply gir gayi ya barh gayi hai.

causes.en: Mains voltage is too high, too low or unstable for the electronics.
causes.ur: Mains voltage electronics ke liye zyada/kam ya unstable hai.

solutions.en: Check mains voltage at the terminals; run again only when the supply is normal.
solutions.ur: Terminal par mains voltage check karein; supply normal hone par hi dobara chalayein.

solutions.en: Put the unit behind a proper voltage stabilizer/protector and retest.
solutions.ur: Unit ke aage sahi stabilizer/protector lagayein aur dobara test karein.

solutions.en: If the wiring and sensors test fine, the main board needs replacing.
solutions.ur: Wiring aur sensor theek nikle to main board badalna hoga.

title.en: Wire controller to master control communication error
title.ur: Wire controller aur master control communication kharabi

meaning.en: The wired controller and the master control board are not exchanging data, so keys and display may go dead.
meaning.ur: Wired controller aur master control board data exchange nahi kar rahe, is liye buttons aur display band ho sakte hain.

causes.en: Wired controller or display board link to the main board is disturbed.
causes.ur: Wired controller ya display board ki main board se link bigdi hui hai.

causes.en: Indoor to outdoor wiring (L, N, S) is loose, rat-bitten or landed wrongly.
causes.ur: Indoor se outdoor ki wiring (L, N, S) dheeli, chuha kata hui ya ghalat lagi hai.

solutions.en: Power cycle both units together; communication faults often clear after one clean restart.
solutions.ur: Dono units ka ek sath power cycle karein; communication fault aksar ek saaf restart se theek ho jata hai.

solutions.en: Power off, then re-check and retighten the indoor-outdoor terminals (L, N, S, earth).
solutions.ur: Power band karke indoor-outdoor terminals (L, N, S, earth) dobara check aur tight karein.

solutions.en: If the wiring and sensors test fine, the main board needs replacing.
solutions.ur: Wiring aur sensor theek nikle to main board badalna hoga.

title.ur: Indoor aur outdoor communication kharabi

meaning.en: The indoor and outdoor units have lost the link between them, so the system stops until contact returns.
meaning.ur: Indoor aur outdoor units ke darmiyan link toot gaya hai, is liye system contact wapas aane tak band ho jata hai.

causes.en: Indoor to outdoor wiring (L, N, S) is loose, rat-bitten or landed wrongly.
causes.ur: Indoor se outdoor ki wiring (L, N, S) dheeli, chuha kata hui ya ghalat lagi hai.

causes.en: Communication circuit on the indoor or outdoor board has failed.
causes.ur: Indoor ya outdoor board ka communication circuit kharab ho gaya hai.

solutions.en: Power cycle both units together; communication faults often clear after one clean restart.
solutions.ur: Dono units ka ek sath power cycle karein; communication fault aksar ek saaf restart se theek ho jata hai.

solutions.en: Power off, then re-check and retighten the indoor-outdoor terminals (L, N, S, earth).
solutions.ur: Power band karke indoor-outdoor terminals (L, N, S, earth) dobara check aur tight karein.

solutions.en: If the wiring and sensors test fine, the main board needs replacing.
solutions.ur: Wiring aur sensor theek nikle to main board badalna hoga.

title.ur: System mein gas kam hai

meaning.en: The charge is too low for the unit to keep running safely, which usually means the circuit is leaking.
meaning.ur: Charge unit ke chalne ke liye bohat kam hai, jo aksar ka matlab hai circuit leak kar raha hai.

causes.en: Refrigerant charge is low because the circuit has leaked.
causes.ur: Circuit mein gas leak hone ki wajah se charge kam hai.

causes.en: Filter drier, capillary or EXV is choked, so pressures run away.
causes.ur: Filter drier, capillary ya EXV block ho gaya hai, pressure balaa se nikal raha hai.

solutions.en: Have the circuit pressure-tested for leaks, then vacuum and re-gas to spec.
solutions.ur: Circuit ka leak test karwayein, phir vacuum karke specification ke mutabiq gas bharwayein.

solutions.en: Leave it off and arrange a leak test with dye before topping up the gas.
solutions.ur: Band chhoonein aur gas dalwane se pehle dye se leak test karwayein.

solutions.en: Do not keep restarting - if the code returns, stop and book a technician.
solutions.ur: Bar bar restart na karein - code wapas aaye to rokein aur technician bulayein.

title.en: Adapter board to outdoor main board communication error
title.ur: Adapter board aur outdoor main board communication kharabi

meaning.en: The adapter board and the outdoor main board have stopped exchanging data across the link.
meaning.ur: Adapter board aur outdoor main board link ke zariye data dena band kar dete hain.

causes.en: Indoor to outdoor wiring (L, N, S) is loose, rat-bitten or landed wrongly.
causes.ur: Indoor se outdoor ki wiring (L, N, S) dheeli, chuha kata hui ya ghalat lagi hai.

causes.en: Communication circuit on the indoor or outdoor board has failed.
causes.ur: Indoor ya outdoor board ka communication circuit kharab ho gaya hai.

solutions.en: Power cycle both units together; communication faults often clear after one clean restart.
solutions.ur: Dono units ka ek sath power cycle karein; communication fault aksar ek saaf restart se theek ho jata hai.

solutions.en: Power off, then re-check and retighten the indoor-outdoor terminals (L, N, S, earth).
solutions.ur: Power band karke indoor-outdoor terminals (L, N, S, earth) dobara check aur tight karein.

solutions.en: If the wiring and sensors test fine, the main board needs replacing.
solutions.ur: Wiring aur sensor theek nikle to main board badalna hoga.

title.ur: Naye aur purane platform ka mismatch

meaning.en: The indoor and outdoor units are from different platform generations and cannot agree on how to run.
meaning.ur: Indoor aur outdoor units alag platform generations ke hain aur chalne ka tareeqa agree nahi kar pa rahe.

causes.en: Indoor and outdoor units are from different platform or revision levels.
causes.ur: Indoor aur outdoor unit alag platform/revision ke hain.

causes.en: Indoor and outdoor units do not match in capacity or model family.
causes.ur: Indoor aur outdoor unit capacity ya model family ke hisab se match nahi karte.

solutions.en: Confirm both units are the same platform and firmware revision, then re-address.
solutions.ur: Dono units ka platform aur firmware revision ek jaisa confirm karke dobara address karein.

solutions.en: Power cycle both units together; communication faults often clear after one clean restart.
solutions.ur: Dono units ka ek sath power cycle karein; communication fault aksar ek saaf restart se theek ho jata hai.

solutions.en: Do not keep restarting - if the code returns, stop and book a technician.
solutions.ur: Bar bar restart na karein - code wapas aaye to rokein aur technician bulayein.

title.ur: Outdoor IPM module ka protection

meaning.en: The inverter power module has shut itself down on an electrical fault to avoid damage.
meaning.ur: Inverter power module ne electrical fault ki wajah se khud ko band kar liya hai taake nuqsan na ho.

causes.en: Inverter/IPM has tripped on over-current, usually from a short in the compressor or drive.
causes.ur: Inverter/IPM over-current par trip hua, aksar compressor ya drive mein short se.

causes.en: Compressor is not picking up speed - weak starting gear or a seized rotor.
causes.ur: Compressor speed nahi pakad raha - starting gear kamzor ya rotor jam hai.

solutions.en: Switch off and leave it off; repeated resets on an IPM trip can kill the compressor.
solutions.ur: Band karke waise hi chhor dein; IPM trip par bar bar reset se compressor kharab ho sakta hai.

solutions.en: Technician to check compressor winding, amp draw and starting gear before any restart.
solutions.ur: Technician compressor ki winding, ampere aur starting gear check kare, phir hi restart karein.

solutions.en: Leave the outdoor cabinet closed; anything behind the panel is technician work.
solutions.ur: Outdoor cabinet na kholein; panel ke piche ka kaam technician ka hai.

source.title: Carrier 45MHHAQ High Wall Heat Pump Owner's Manual - Table 4 Error Codes

title.ur: Outdoor unit ki voltage protection

meaning.en: The outdoor unit has cut out because the supply voltage went outside the safe window.
meaning.ur: Outdoor unit is liye cut ho gayi kyunki supply voltage safe range se bahar chali gayi.

causes.en: Mains voltage is too high, too low or unstable for the electronics.
causes.ur: Mains voltage electronics ke liye zyada/kam ya unstable hai.

causes.en: Three-phase supply is missing a phase or the phase order is reversed.
causes.ur: Teen-phase supply mein phase missing hai ya phase order ulti hai.

solutions.en: Check mains voltage at the terminals; run again only when the supply is normal.
solutions.ur: Terminal par mains voltage check karein; supply normal hone par hi dobara chalayein.

solutions.en: Put the unit behind a proper voltage stabilizer/protector and retest.
solutions.ur: Unit ke aage sahi stabilizer/protector lagayein aur dobara test karein.

solutions.en: Electrician to verify phase sequence and that no phase is missing before restart.
solutions.ur: Electrician phase order aur missing phase check kare, phir restart ho.

source.title: Carrier 45MHHAQ High Wall Heat Pump Owner's Manual - Table 4 Error Codes

title.en: Compressor top or IPM temperature protection
title.ur: Compressor top ya IPM ka temperature protection

meaning.en: The compressor top or the module has overheated, so the unit has stopped it before damage happens.
meaning.ur: Compressor top ya module overheat ho gaya hai, is liye unit ne nuqsan se pehle use rok diya hai.

causes.en: Compressor is running hot from low gas, a dirty coil or a heavy load.
causes.ur: Gas kam, coil ganda ya load zyada hone se compressor garam ho raha hai.

causes.en: Outdoor fan cannot move air because the coil or grille is choked.
causes.ur: Coil ya grille band hone ki wajah se outdoor fan hawa nahi hata pa raha.

causes.en: Indoor or outdoor heat exchanger is choked with dust and cannot breathe.
causes.ur: Indoor ya outdoor heat exchanger dust se band hai, unit saans nahi le pa rahi.

solutions.en: From outside only, clear anything blocking the outdoor unit and give it room to breathe.
solutions.ur: Sirf bahar se outdoor unit ke rukhawat hata dein aur khula space dein.

solutions.en: Service the unit: clean filters and coils, then check running pressures and amps.
solutions.ur: Unit ka service karein: filter/coil saaf karein, phir pressure aur ampere check karein.

solutions.en: Technician to check compressor winding, amp draw and starting gear before any restart.
solutions.ur: Technician compressor ki winding, ampere aur starting gear check kare, phir hi restart karein.

source.title: Carrier 45MHHAQ High Wall Heat Pump Owner's Manual - Table 4 Error Codes

title.ur: Pressure protection, low ya high

meaning.en: Either head or suction pressure has left its safe band, so the unit has locked out the compressor.
meaning.ur: Head ya suction pressure dono mein se koi bhi safe range se bahar chala gaya hai, is liye unit ne compressor lock kar diya.

causes.en: Condenser is dirty or its fan is weak, so head pressure climbs and trips.
causes.ur: Condenser ganda ya fan kamzor, head pressure barha kar trip kar deta hai.

causes.en: Refrigerant charge is low because the circuit has leaked.
causes.ur: Circuit mein gas leak hone ki wajah se charge kam hai.

causes.en: Indoor or outdoor heat exchanger is choked with dust and cannot breathe.
causes.ur: Indoor ya outdoor heat exchanger dust se band hai, unit saans nahi le pa rahi.

solutions.en: Service the unit: clean filters and coils, then check running pressures and amps.
solutions.ur: Unit ka service karein: filter/coil saaf karein, phir pressure aur ampere check karein.

solutions.en: Have the circuit pressure-tested for leaks, then vacuum and re-gas to spec.
solutions.ur: Circuit ka leak test karwayein, phir vacuum karke specification ke mutabiq gas bharwayein.

solutions.en: Leave the outdoor cabinet closed; anything behind the panel is technician work.
solutions.ur: Outdoor cabinet na kholein; panel ke piche ka kaam technician ka hai.

source.title: Carrier 45MHHAQ High Wall Heat Pump Owner's Manual - Table 4 Error Codes

title.ur: Inverter compressor drive kharabi

meaning.en: The drive cannot spin the compressor normally, which points at the drive, the compressor or the link between them.
meaning.ur: Drive compressor ko normal tarah ghumaa nahi pa rahi, jo drive, compressor ya inke darmiyan link ki taraf ishara karta hai.

causes.en: Inverter/IPM has tripped on over-current, usually from a short in the compressor or drive.
causes.ur: Inverter/IPM over-current par trip hua, aksar compressor ya drive mein short se.

causes.en: Compressor is not picking up speed - weak starting gear or a seized rotor.
causes.ur: Compressor speed nahi pakad raha - starting gear kamzor ya rotor jam hai.

causes.en: Compressor lead wiring or drive output is out of sequence.
causes.ur: Compressor ki wiring ya drive output ki sequence ghalat hai.

solutions.en: Switch off and leave it off; repeated resets on an IPM trip can kill the compressor.
solutions.ur: Band karke waise hi chhor dein; IPM trip par bar bar reset se compressor kharab ho sakta hai.

solutions.en: Technician to check compressor winding, amp draw and starting gear before any restart.
solutions.ur: Technician compressor ki winding, ampere aur starting gear check kare, phir hi restart karein.

solutions.en: If the wiring and sensors test fine, the main board needs replacing.
solutions.ur: Wiring aur sensor theek nikle to main board badalna hoga.

source.title: Carrier 45MHHAQ High Wall Heat Pump Owner's Manual - Table 4 Error Codes

title.ur: Kam ambient temperature ki wajah se protection

meaning.en: It is too cold outside for the unit to run, so it has locked out to protect the compressor and oil.
meaning.ur: Bahar itni sardi hai ke unit chalna safe nahi lagti, compressor aur oil ki hifazat ke liye lock ho gayi hai.

causes.en: Ambient temperature has fallen below the unit's minimum operating limit.
causes.ur: Bahar ka temperature unit ki minimum limit se neeche chala gaya hai.

causes.en: The thermistor has drifted out of range or failed outright.
causes.ur: Thermistor kharab ho gaya hai ya uski reading ghalat aa rahi hai.

solutions.en: Wait for the ambient to rise; if it appears in mild weather, get the unit checked.
solutions.ur: Ambient ke barhne ka intezar karein; mausam saada mein aaye to unit check karwayein.

solutions.en: Check the sensor plug and lead, then measure the thermistor and replace it if out of range.
solutions.ur: Sensor ka plug aur wire check karein, thermistor napein, ghalat ho to badlein.

solutions.en: Do not keep restarting - if the code returns, stop and book a technician.
solutions.ur: Bar bar restart na karein - code wapas aaye to rokein aur technician bulayein.

source.title: Carrier 45MHHAQ High Wall Heat Pump Owner's Manual - Table 4 Error Codes

title.ur: Indoor units ka mode conflict

meaning.en: The display shows dashes because two indoor units are asking the one outdoor unit for opposite modes.
meaning.ur: Display dashes is liye dikhata hai ke do indoor units usi outdoor unit se ulat mode maang rahe hain.

causes.en: Two indoor units are calling for opposite modes - one heating, one cooling.
causes.ur: Do indoor units ulat mode maang rahe hain - ek heating, ek cooling.

causes.en: Indoor and outdoor units are from different platform or revision levels.
causes.ur: Indoor aur outdoor unit alag platform/revision ke hain.

solutions.en: Set every indoor unit to the same mode, or let the master unit decide the mode.
solutions.ur: Har indoor unit ko ek hi mode par rakhein, ya mode master unit par chhoonein.

solutions.en: Switch all indoor units off, then start them together in one mode.
solutions.ur: Sab indoor units band karein, phir ek hi mode mein ek sath start karein.

solutions.en: Do not keep restarting - if the code returns, stop and book a technician.
solutions.ur: Bar bar restart na karein - code wapas aaye to rokein aur technician bulayein.

notes.en: A blank or dashed display is the manual's own way of reporting the mode clash, not a dead display.
notes.ur: Khali ya dashed display manual ka tarika hai mode clash dikhane ka, display marna nahi hai.

source.title: Carrier 45MHHAQ High Wall Heat Pump Owner's Manual - Table 4 Error Codes

title.ur: Defrost mode chal raha hai

meaning.en: The unit is melting frost off the outdoor coil while heating; the manual states DF is not an error code.
meaning.ur: Heating ke dauran unit outdoor coil se barf pighal rahi hai; manual ke mutabiq DF error code nahi hai.

causes.en: Ambient temperature has fallen below the unit's minimum operating limit.
causes.ur: Bahar ka temperature unit ki minimum limit se neeche chala gaya hai.

causes.en: Room heat load is above what the unit can handle (open doors, sun load, crowd).
causes.ur: Kamre ka load unit se zyada hai (khuli khirkiyan, dhoop, zyada log).

solutions.en: Switch the unit off, wait 5 minutes and start it again from the remote.
solutions.ur: Unit band karein, 5 minute ruk kar remote se dobara start karein.

solutions.en: Wait for the ambient to rise; if it appears in mild weather, get the unit checked.
solutions.ur: Ambient ke barhne ka intezar karein; mausam saada mein aaye to unit check karwayein.

solutions.en: From outside only, clear anything blocking the outdoor unit and give it room to breathe.
solutions.ur: Sirf bahar se outdoor unit ke rukhawat hata dein aur khula space dein.

notes.en: Normal status display, listed in the error table only so technicians do not confuse it with a fault.
notes.ur: Normal status display, sirf is liye error table mein hai taake technician ise fault na samajhein.

source.title: Carrier 45MHHAQ High Wall Heat Pump Owner's Manual - Table 4 Error Codes

title.ur: Forced cooling mode chal raha hai

meaning.en: The unit is in forced cooling, usually started from the remote or during service; the manual says FC is not an error code.
meaning.ur: Unit forced cooling par hai, jo aksar remote se ya service ke dauran chalu hoti hai; manual ke mutabiq FC error code nahi hai.

causes.en: Installation issue - piping length, flare quality or charge was never right.
causes.ur: Installation ka masla - piping lambai, flare ya charge kabhi theek nahi hua.

causes.en: Two indoor units are calling for opposite modes - one heating, one cooling.
causes.ur: Do indoor units ulat mode maang rahe hain - ek heating, ek cooling.

solutions.en: Set every indoor unit to the same mode, or let the master unit decide the mode.
solutions.ur: Har indoor unit ko ek hi mode par rakhein, ya mode master unit par chhoonein.

solutions.en: Switch the unit off, wait 5 minutes and start it again from the remote.
solutions.ur: Unit band karein, 5 minute ruk kar remote se dobara start karein.

solutions.en: Do not keep restarting - if the code returns, stop and book a technician.
solutions.ur: Bar bar restart na karein - code wapas aaye to rokein aur technician bulayein.

notes.en: Normal status display - switch the unit off and start it normally to leave FC.
notes.ur: Normal status display - unit band karke normal tarah start karein to FC chala jata hai.
